mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or the signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a high level of consumer credit (RSAFS) signals excessive leverage and potential financial instability, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when RSAFS is above its 90th percentile, or the signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 (thousands of units) signals a cooling real estate market, which reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or the signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and HOUST declines, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strong real estate market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 90th percentile, or the signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
